english.note: This is the all-purpose possessive phrase for belongings or affiliations involving the speaker's group, with context normally showing whether the addressee is included.

examples.english: Our school is holding a sports day this year.
examples.traditional: 我哋嘅學校今年搞運動會。
examples.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 ge3 hok6 haau6 gam1 nin4 gaau2 wan6 dung6 wui2
